title: Cryptographic circuit optimization
summary: 32 fixed linear-layer, binary-field multiplier and block-MDS problems. Six bounded agent sessions advanced two Whirlwind maps; larger beta recommended, public donor intake paused.

review.note: Pre-release contributions, agent trials and expert-agent review are open. Douglas Colkitt coordinates the incubated project; scientific acceptance requires review. No fixed review throughput or completed expert signoff is implied. See PARTICIPATION.md.

credit.policy: Preserve published authors, source commits and hashes. Credit reproduction, code, search and review separately; no automatic coauthorship.

requirements.note: Python 3.9+ standard library; first verification fetches pinned optional SBP data. C++17 for agent search, optional Z3 for selected AES experiments. See README.
